scope: Cochrane, The Fiscal Theory of the Price Level, Chapter 7 (with Online Appendix A1.2.1, A1.14): Long-term debt dynamics. The maturity structure with flow and present-value relations (equivalent under transversality); forward guidance and bond-price targets (T >= k sharp), with discrete and continuous closed forms; maturing debt as a buffer; bond sales, dilution and unit elasticity; future sales in three periods; the general formula (7.17) with the explicit chain-sum weights, its convergence under a row condition, uniqueness of the price level without buy-backs, and a counterexample showing the present-value system need not determine the price level; policy constraints (Theorem P), QE trade-offs; quantitative easing with existence and uniqueness of the required purchases. Printed errors corrected with Lean counterexamples.
source: John H. Cochrane, The Fiscal Theory of the Price Level, Princeton University Press, Chapter 7, pp. 212-236, and Online Appendix A1.2.1 and A1.14.
